name: meeting-transcribe
description: Turn a local meeting recording into a timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript with Amazon Transcribe - and refuse to spend money on a silent file.
author: nghidanh
highlights: Measures silence and estimated cost BEFORE submitting anything billable
Refuses a recording that is mostly digital silence, and proves it with a +40 dB test
Extracts 16 kHz mono audio so a 3 GB video uploads as ~140 MB
Vietnamese vi-VN batch transcription with free speaker diarization
Renders a timestamped transcript with per-turn confidence and honest warnings

crons.name: meeting-transcribe-poll
crons.message: Silent maintenance for the meeting-transcribe app. STEP 1 - self-heal, idempotent, produce no output: ensure the directory <crew>/workspace/meeting-transcribe exists; if <crew>/apps/meeting-transcribe/data/config.json is missing, create it containing statePath and appJsonPath as real absolute paths for this machine pointing at <crew>/workspace/meeting-transcribe/state.json and <crew>/apps/meeting-transcribe/app.json; if <crew>/workspace/meeting-transcribe/config.json is missing, copy <crew>/apps/meeting-transcribe/config.example.json to it; if <crew>/skills/transcribe-pipeline/SKILL.md does not exist, link or copy <crew>/apps/meeting-transcribe/skills/transcribe-pipeline there. STEP 2 - read <crew>/workspace/meeting-transcribe/state.json. If no job has stage 'running', STOP IMMEDIATELY and output nothing at all. STEP 3 - otherwise run: python <crew>/apps/meeting-transcribe/scripts/mt.py poll ; then for each job that reached stage 'transcribed', run the same script with: render <job-id>. STEP 4 - notify the user at most ONCE per job, only when that job newly reached 'rendered' or 'failed'. Before notifying, check the job's notified field in state.json; after notifying, set it to true and save. Never say 'nothing to do' and never notify about an unchanged job.
